assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument only records hours spent on income-generating economic activities in the main occupation (Question 513) and secondary occupation (Question 518). It explicitly instructs interviewers to exclude household chores when capturing work (Question 501: 'Sin contar los quehaceres del hogar'). The instrument does not contain a time-use schedule or questions asking respondents how they allocate or spend time across multiple daily activities such as unpaid household chores, care work, education, or leisure.
